route_title: UV-Centered Quarter-Wave Stack for Maximum Excitation Suppression
compilation_rationale: Bounded 36-layer DBR stack defined with fixed Ta2O5/SiO2 sequence and optimized thicknesses. Three mean transmittance targets cover all requested spectral bands. Coherent smatrix solver applied to planar isotropic geometry at normal incidence. No higher-fidelity effects required.
